## Goal

Provide CLI commands to modify existing bugs without touching jsonl files directly.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket new --body <file>` or `--body -` to create bug with full body
- [ ] `docket update <id> --body <file>` to update bug body from file
- [ ] `docket update <id> --body -` to update bug body from stdin
- [ ] `docket update <id> --title <new-title>` to change title
- [ ] `docket update <id> --priority <level>` to change priority
- [ ] Consider `docket edit <id>` opening $EDITOR (already filed as nzxx)

## Context

Currently to modify a bug's body after creation, you have to:
1. Manually construct JSON event
2. Append to the .jsonl file

This is error-prone and unfriendly. We need proper CLI commands.

Possible approaches:
- `docket update` subcommand with flags
- `docket new` accepting `--body` for full body at creation
- Pipe-friendly: `cat body.md | docket update <id> --body -`
